items.title: AI-Powered Telegram Expense Assistant
items.description: Built a dual-path, event-driven financial assistant on Telegram. The media path processes receipt photos, bank-transfer screenshots and PDFs, combines visual evidence with user captions, extracts strict JSON with Gemini 2.5 Flash and records transactions in Google Sheets. The text path retrieves and aggregates ledger rows so users can ask natural-language questions about weekly, monthly or date-specific spending and receive concise answers in Telegram.
items.description_so: Waxaan dhisay kaaliye maaliyadeed oo Telegram ah oo leh laba hab-socod. Sawirrada rasiidyada, wareejinta bangiga iyo PDF-yada waxaa lagu daraa qoraalka isticmaalaha; Gemini 2.5 Flash wuxuu ka soo saaraa JSON, macaamilladana waxaa lagu kaydiyaa Google Sheets. Habka qoraalku wuxuu isu geeyaa xogta si looga jawaabo su’aalaha kharashaadka toddobaadle, bille ama maalin gaar ah.
items.methods: Make.com; Telegram Bot API; Google Gemini 2.5 Flash; Google Drive; Google Sheets; multimodal extraction; JSON parsing; workflow routing; text aggregation

The project includes editable Illustrator artwork, logo variations, concept development, application mockups, a first-place certificate, a winner’s plaque and presentation photographs. Mockups demonstrate proposed applications; they are not claims of manufactured merchandise.

items.title: RavenStack Customer Retention & Revenue Analytics

The team created descriptive, diagnostic and predictive dashboards covering churn, customer risk and recurring revenue. My documented contribution: dataset preparation, data cleaning, data modelling and relationships in Power BI, plus support for dashboard visuals and DAX measures. The report records a 22% churn rate and 78 active accounts classified as high risk. Risk classification was rule-based; the dataset is simulated.
items.description_so: Waxaan falanqaynay shan xog-ururin oo isku xiran oo ganacsi SaaS la matalay leh 500 akoon. Kooxdu waxay dhistay dashboards ku saabsan macaamiisha baxaysa, khataraha iyo dakhliga soo noqnoqda. Doorkaygu wuxuu ahaa diyaarinta iyo nadiifinta xogta, samaynta xiriirrada iyo moodeelka Power BI, iyo taageeridda muuqaalada iyo cabbirrada DAX. Warbixintu waxay diiwaangelisay bixitaan 22% ah iyo 78 akoon oo firfircoon oo khatar sare leh. Kala saaristu waxay ku salaysnayd xeerar, xogtuna waa mid la matalay.
